Restated before interest: LLY paid $3,152mm of interest inside operating cash flow over 2018 to 2025, 1.17% of revenue. Checked without one-off cash: deal payments are booked under investing, so free cash flow never carried them, and no settlement or transition tax is stated for the window, so the charge stands. Restated without working capital build: over 2018 to 2025 LLY's cash flow statement shows receivables up $15,658mm, inventories up $10,223mm, payables and accrued liabilities up $18,257mm, a working capital build of $7,624mm, 2.83% of revenue. Growth ties that cash up once, not on every product for ever, so the charge falls from 20.25% to 16.87%.
